original.target_description: Experiment 2: naming ink colors of incongruent words versus naming colored squares, within-person

n.quote: One hundred students (88 college undergraduates, 29 males and 59 females, and 12 graduate students, all females) served as subjects.
n.exclusions: No participant exclusions stated; uncorrected errors penalized by twice average per-word time.

es.quote: The difference of 47 seconds is 2.5 standard deviation units in terms of the NCWd test or 4.35 standard deviation units on the NC test.
es.metric: standard deviation units relative to incongruent word-color test

replication.target_description: Study 1/4.1: within-person incongruent versus congruent color-word response latency; D scoring; aggregate

n.sample_role: participants included in target aggregate analysis
n.exclusions: Trials above 10,000 ms removed; error latencies replaced by condition correct-response mean plus 600 ms.

reported_success.quote: This replicated the basic effect from previous research.

notes: Printed N = 3,279 conflicts with printed t df = 3,336; retained explicit N without resolving the discrepancy. Original comparison is word-color versus colored squares; replication uses incongruent versus congruent words. No p value printed for this comparison. Also prints 4.35 standard deviation units relative to the colored-square test; retained 2.5 using incongruent test SD, without conversion.
